rca_of_issue.bug: TypeError: t is not a function in AccountRow (CrmAccountsPage.jsx line 243)
rca_of_issue.root_cause: AccountRow is a module-level functional component that uses t() for translations but was missing const { t } = useT() inside the component body. The useT() hook must be called inside each component that uses t(). AccountCard (same file, line 253) correctly had useT() inside it, but AccountRow didn't.
rca_of_issue.fix: Added const { t } = useT(); inside AccountRow component body
rca_of_issue.reproduction: Navigate to /crm/archived or /crm/follow-ups, click the table view icon button (second of two icon buttons next to 'Nuovo Account')
